description: This file contains C source code implementing DRM platform initialization, deinitialization, and a decrypt proxy function for PlayReady DRM, with functions interfacing with secure pointers and handling buffer conversions.

methods.name: DRM_RESULT drm_playready_platform_init()
methods.description: Initializes the DRM platform library, logs a warning message, and returns success.

methods.name: DRM_RESULT drm_playready_platform_deinit()
methods.description: Deinitializes the DRM platform library, logs a warning message, and returns success.
